description: This PHP script handles WiFi spectrum analysis diagnostics, including session management, MAC address translation, data retrieval from device parameters, and outputting WiFi neighbor scan results in JSON format.

methods.name: mac_translate
methods.description: Converts MAC addresses to a standardized colon-separated uppercase format.

methods.name: rearrange_SDTR
methods.description: Rearranges the Supported Data Transfer Rates string by adding line breaks after certain entries.

methods.name: get_results
methods.description: Retrieves WiFi neighbor scan results, processes BSSID MAC addresses, and returns the data in JSON format.
